truthBoundary.rule: No system may represent an FCC authorization, certification, waiver, market-access grant, or compliance status as granted unless supported by authoritative evidence.

framework.name: SPACE_AND_EARTH_STATION_SERVICES
framework.effectiveDateRule: Track the Part 100 Effective Date and any rule-specific effective dates from FCC/Space Bureau primary sources before changing operative status.

definitions.VTSS_SYSTEM: One or more space stations operating beyond geosynchronous orbit or without fixed/predictable orbital patterns over the lifetime under one call sign; may include orbital transfer, rendezvous/proximity, in-space servicing, lunar or other celestial-body missions.
definitions.MOSS_SYSTEM: Two or more types of satellite systems operating together under one space-station call sign; each component remains subject to its otherwise applicable rules.
definitions.NATIONWIDE_NON_SITE_EARTH_STATION: A single license for one or more immovable earth stations that may operate in the United States and territories subject to applicable site registration requirements.

processingRules.action: FCC informs applicant/public of reasons preventing action if full action has not occurred

decisionPolicy.waiverRequiredWhen: Applicant cannot certify compliance with an applicable Commission rule requiring affirmative certification
decisionPolicy.conditionalGrant: Represent as a distinct authorization state with explicit unsatisfied conditions; never collapse to GRANTED.

transitionRules: Track Part 100 effective-date announcements as primary-source events.
New authorization applications after the Part 100 Effective Date must follow Part 100 application processes.
Pending pre-effective-date applications require transition-aware handling and are not assumed to receive new processing timelines.
Existing processing-round status is not retroactively changed solely by adoption of the Order.
Current license terms remain unless changed through an authorized transition mechanism; one-year extension election rules must be evaluated against the effective date.
Technical or operational inability to comply with Part 100 routes to waiver/transition procedures, not silent exception.
